title: Normalized Event
description: Frozen internal event contract. All input paths - packet/EVE and NetFlow v9/IPFIX flow records - converge here. The only difference between paths is the capability state attached by the adapter. Source: FINAL_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN_V6.3.md section 6.1.

observed_time.description: Original packet/record timestamp. Never silently treated as current live time.

display_time.description: Replay-rebased time. t_replay_start + (t_packet - t_pcap_start) / replay_speed, where t_replay_start is captured ONCE at replay start. Never re-evaluate 'now' per packet - that drifts the clock at roughly 2x.

direction.description: Derived from config/address_plan.yaml enclave prefixes. exfil.py cannot exist without this.

flow_id.description: Present where an alertable observation exists. sha256(canonical_value).hexdigest()[:16] - exactly 16 lowercase hex chars, a 64-bit truncated SHA-256. NOT 16 bytes. Phase 0 decision DOC-006.

flow_summary.description: Produced by the bounded in-process flow tracker on the header path, NOT by Suricata EVE flow output. EVE flow events stay disabled (section 6.2); the capability probe asserts flow events == 0.

registered_domain.description: eTLD+1 after TLD stripping. Used as a dns_tunnel dedup-key component; takes the NOT_OBSERVABLE sentinel when unavailable.

tls.description: Handshake metadata and fingerprints only. No decrypted or payload-content field exists in this contract, so decryption cannot enter the pipeline even by accident. Missing fingerprints are capability state, not evidence of benign traffic.

shape.description: Concrete traffic metadata, never a generic anomaly label (section 10.6). Never inspects decrypted payload bytes.

input_mode.description: FROZEN enum. Describes the primary input contract, not an internal combination such as pcap_replay+eve. Sensor subpaths live in capability state. 'sflow' is a valid input mode - NOT_OBSERVABLE is a per-detector evidence state, never a property of an input mode.

sensor_loss.description: Loss is surfaced as evidence, never hidden. Where only one estimator exists, report kernel_drops and label it a lower bound. Do not invent a more precise number.

exporter.description: NetFlow v9 / IPFIX only. Template state is bounded and evicted by exporter/template identity and timeout; a malformed or attacker-controlled template stream must not create unbounded parser state.

capability.description: Evidence-visibility axis. Missing evidence is NEVER converted into a benign result.

capability_state.description: Evidence-visibility axis, per detector or field. Distinct from the component-health axis (HEALTHY | DEGRADED | UNAVAILABLE), which describes a component being down and never appears here.
